title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater/Maps
text:
These are the layouts of all nine levels of Tony Hawk's Pro Skater. Some levels have two versions: one with the collectibles and starting point marked out and one without said markers. Arrows on the markers indicate that the collectible is hiding behind or inside an obstruction.

The ones with the markers have the following:
 A blue chevron arrow for the starting potion and the direction in which the player will face.
 Green ovals with a 1, 2, or 5 on them for the bonus points; 1 is 100 points, 2 is 200 points, and 5 is 500 points.
 Yellow S-K-A-T-E letters for their locations.
 Red circles to pinpoint the five objects the skater must collect, grind, destroy, etc.
 The location of the hidden tape with a white VHS cassette.
